nodes.spec: Continuity kernel — the witnessed ledger; packets rendered, never hand-written. One half of the north-star union.
Intent control plane — OpenSpec artifacts + merge-tools; binds intent to continuity. Other half of the north-star union.
A2A transport — agent-to-agent comms / observable heartbeat substrate.
Merge/lock substrate — symbol-level conflict resolution + locks for cross-repo merges.

Persistent-memory organ (Infinite Context Memory) — recall/store across sessions; SQLite+sqlite-vec+FTS5 store, fastembed embeddings, 31 MCP tools, ~40 CLI verbs, axum dashboard. Candidate canonical memory plane binding into the handoff+rusty-idd union.
